name: S&S Healthcare Holding Ltd.
summary: S&S Healthcare Holding Ltd. is dedicated to the research, manufacturing, and global commercialization of medical imaging equipment. The company's operations extend across international markets, including significant presences in Taiwan, the United States, and Switzerland. Its product portfolio encompasses advanced digital diagnostic X-ray systems, alongside the engineering and production of devices for bone densitometry and body composition assessment. Established in 1988, S&S Healthcare maintains its headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan. The firm adopted its current name in August 2020, having previously operated as Swissray Global Healthcare Holding Ltd.
